settings.title: Settings
settings.mail_hostname_helper: Name of the SMTP and IMAP server and of the mailcow web interface. Point its A record, and the MX record of your mail domains, to this node.
settings.clamd_enabled_helper: ClamAV needs about 1 GB of RAM more and downloads its signatures at the first start.
settings.netfilter_external_description: netfilter-mailcow runs with "Manage Fail2Ban externally": it keeps the mailcow ban list, published at https://HOST/f2b-banlist.php?id=TOKEN (the token is in the mailcow UI, Configuration > Fail2ban), and changes no firewall rule.
settings.netfilter_rootful_description: netfilter-mailcow bans attackers itself, with the NET_ADMIN capability over the network namespace of the mailcow pod: banned clients cannot reach the mail ports. The node firewall is not changed.
settings.netfilter_disabled_description: netfilter-mailcow does not run. Brute-force protection relies on NS8 CrowdSec.
settings.mail_ports_description: mailcow opens the TCP ports {ports} on the node firewall. It replaces the NS8 Mail app: both cannot run on the same node. Install NS8 CrowdSec to ban attackers on the node firewall.
settings.mail_module_on_node: The NS8 Mail app ({value}) runs on this node and uses the mail ports: mailcow cannot run with it
settings.mail_port_in_use: Another service uses the ports {value} of this node
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
